payload.report_excerpt: Sparse mixture-of-experts models are now understood to deliver dense-equivalent quality at roughly one third of the inference latency [Bex, 2022].
payload.source_excerpt: Routing to k of n experts reduces training FLOPs to reach a fixed validation loss by 2.9x against a dense baseline. Inference-time wall-clock depends on the serving topology and expert placement; we do not report latency measurements.
